messages:
Riley: FYI — HQ Finance (acct: HQ-FIN-23) reporting tail latency spikes on embeddings API hitting SLA. Customer success flagged urgent. Can ENG take ownership? Details in support ticket: https://redwood.support/ticket/5842 :exclamation:
Alex: On it. tagging @Sam for oncall. Initial ask: can we triage + propose temporary mitigation (rate-limit / cache tweak) and give an ETA for a workaround?
Sam: I'm oncall. Looking at logs now. Seeing p95 for embeddings.generate jump from ~420ms -> ~1.8s. Possible KV cache thrashing on long-tail sequences. Can repro locally with customer workload sample. Need ~30m for triage.
Riley: :thumbsup: please loop me with updates — customer needs a formal workaround timeline.
OncallBot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-5842 opened (sev: 2). Response team: eng-oncall, eng-platform.
Alex: Ownership: eng-platform owns RCA + patch, eng-oncall owns mitigation + rollout. Proposed plan: 1) enable per-customer prefix cache (short TTL) + rollback, 2) temporary rate-limit on heavy embedding requests, 3) collect traces. Can we target a canary rollout in 2 hours?
Sam: Can do mitigation in ~45m — I'll push a config that sets cache TTL=60s for that tenant and add a 2x concurrency cap. Will run canary in dedicated region and monitor token latency.
Maya: Customer expects "reduction in SLA violations within 4 hours" as a formal timeline. If canary shows improvement in <1h they'll accept as temporary workaround. Also asking for a patch by EOD tomorrow.
Alex: Agree to EOD patch. Sam — once canary is up post the canary link + p95 numbers after 20m. I'll prepare rollback steps and a short runbook.
Sam: Canary deployed to us-west-2 canary pool. Initial p95 numbers: 1.8s -> 760ms, p50 stable. Rolling to 10% traffic now. Quick repro command we used: ```curl -X POST https://us-west-2.canary.api.redwood/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"<sample-batch>"}'```
Riley: I'll update the customer: telling them we're rolling a canary and expect tangible improvements within 1h. I'll also ask if they want official SLA credit docs.
Alex: FYI dependency: cache config change touches Dedicated pools and requires eng-infra review for the network ACL change — tagging infra.
Sam: Monitoring dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/embeddings/tenant/HQ-FIN-23 — p95 trending down after canary. I'll post 15m cadence updates here.
Riley: Thanks all. If anything regresses or we need exec escalation ping me and @Maya.
